caption: Hampoort, Grave
composition: Classicist land gate of 1688 from the field side · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Hampoort at Grave is the brick city gate finished in 1688, in the Dutch classicist manner, with a pediment on the land side. The passage bends, so the street beyond is not seen straight through. It is partly cloudy, about 9.2°C, with wind near 7.9 km/h and cloud cover about 50%. The museum inside is closed. The coats of arms and the year are not readable. It is not a water gate and not a church.
